name: Riftseeker’s Sanctum
summary: A planar‑anchor nexus where Riftseekers manipulate temporal geometry and monitor Discord’s deeper anomalies.
description: Riftseeker’s Sanctum is the planar heart of Kuua — a crystalline nexus where Riftseekers observe, stabilize, and manipulate temporal seams. The Sanctum predates the Muramite invasion, built by planar custodians who sought to contain Discord’s deeper ruptures. Muramite forces avoid the Sanctum, unable to fully comprehend or control its geometry. Temporal echoes, planar constructs, and crystalline guardians roam its halls, while Riftseekers maintain delicate balance across Kuua’s fractured reality.
